text: いつ　ポケモンの　たいりょくが　たりなく　なるか　わかんない　もんね

structure.jp: ポケモンの　たいりょくが
わかんない　もんね

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Adjective い changes to く, then なる means 'become'. たりなくなる = 'become insufficient'.

patterns.name: 〜もの
patterns.explanation: もの (もん) at the end gives a reason, a bit like 'because, you know'. わかんないもんね = 'well, you can't tell, right'.

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: なるか　わかんない
patterns.explanation: か inside a sentence turns a question into part of it. いつ...なるか　わからない = 'don't know when it will become...'
